name: motion
description: Use your phone as a full-body motion controller for a browser game.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter motion-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter motion-web run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm check:landing
scripts.deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy landing --project-name motion --branch main
